title: nginx 1.10.3 — End-of-Life with Known Critical CVEs
description: nginx 1.10.3 (Ubuntu) is EOL since 2017. Affected by CVE-2017-7529 (integer overflow range filter, CVSS 7.5), CVE-2019-9511-9516 (HTTP/2 DoS), and others. Unpatched for ~7+ years.
risks: Remote attackers can exploit known nginx CVEs for info disclosure, DoS, or potential RCE on e-commerce platform.
attack_vectors: CVE-2017-7529: Send crafted Range header with negative offset to read cached data beyond intended range. CVE-2019-9511-9516: HTTP/2 Rapid Reset attacks.
poc: nikto -h https://playtunisie.com (Server header reveals nginx/1.10.3); nuclei -u https://playtunisie.com -tags nginx
proof_of_existence: nikto output: + Server: nginx/1.10.3 (Ubuntu). nuclei nginx scan returned empty (templates may not cover this version). nmap CVE-2017-7529 check was blocked by scope restriction on IP.
remediation: Upgrade nginx to latest stable version (1.25.x+) and apply all security patches.

title: Deprecated TLS Protocols Enabled (TLSv1.0, TLSv1.1)
description: Server accepts TLSv1.0 and TLSv1.1 which are deprecated (RFC 8996). Vulnerable to BEAST, POODLE, and other downgrade attacks.
risks: Man-in-the-middle attacks via protocol downgrade; compliance violations (PCI-DSS requires TLS 1.2+).
attack_vectors: Force downgrade to TLSv1.0/1.1, exploit BEAST or POODLE padding oracle attacks to decrypt traffic.
proof_of_existence: sslscan output: TLSv1.0 enabled (yellow), TLSv1.1 enabled (yellow), TLSv1.3 disabled (yellow). TLSv1.2 only modern protocol enabled.
remediation: Disable TLSv1.0 and TLSv1.1; enable TLSv1.3 in nginx ssl_protocols directive.

title: TLS 1.3 Disabled — Missing Modern Protocol Support
description: TLSv1.3 is disabled. Missing improved security features: 0-RTT, forward secrecy by default, removed weak algorithms.
risks: Suboptimal TLS posture; missing performance and security benefits of TLS 1.3; clients limited to TLS 1.2 max.
attack_vectors: No direct exploit; but missing TLS 1.3 1-RTT handshake improvements and mandatory forward secrecy.
proof_of_existence: sslscan output: TLSv1.3 disabled (yellow). Only TLSv1.0, 1.1, 1.2 enabled.
remediation: Enable TLSv1.3 in nginx configuration: ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;

title: Weak DHE Key Exchange (1024-bit)
description: Server supports DHE-RSA cipher suites with only 1024-bit DH parameters, below NIST SP 800-131A minimum (2048-bit).
risks: Weak DH parameters susceptible to precomputation attacks (Logjam); allows decryption of captured traffic.
attack_vectors: Logjam-style attack: precompute common 1024-bit DH groups to decrypt TLS sessions using DHE-RSA ciphers.
proof_of_existence: sslscan output: DHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384 DHE 1024 bits; DHE-RSA-AES256-SHA256 DHE 1024 bits; multiple DHE suites at 1024 bits.
remediation: Generate and use 2048-bit+ DH parameters; prefer ECDHE suites; disable weak DHE ciphers.

title: Missing X-Frame-Options Header — Clickjacking Risk
description: X-Frame-Options header absent. Site can be embedded in iframes, enabling clickjacking/UI redress attacks.
risks: Attackers can overlay transparent iframes to trick users into performing unintended actions on e-commerce site.
attack_vectors: Embed playtunisie.com in transparent iframe, overlay decoy UI elements to capture clicks on payment/checkout buttons.
proof_of_existence: nikto output: + The anti-clickjacking X-Frame-Options header is not present.
remediation: Add 'X-Frame-Options: DENY' or 'SAMEORIGIN' header in nginx config.

title: No WAF Detected on Target
description: No WAF signatures observed in responses. nikto completed scans without rate limiting or blocking. No WAF cookie/header artifacts detected.
risks: No layer-7 protection against OWASP Top 10 attacks (SQLi, XSS, RCE) on e-commerce platform.
attack_vectors: Direct exploitation of web vulns without WAF filtering — SQLi, XSS, file upload attacks proceed unimpeded.
poc: nikto -h https://playtunisie.com -Tuning 1 (completed 1707 checks without WAF interference)
proof_of_existence: nikto ran 1707 items checked with 0 errors, completed normally. No WAF blocking patterns observed. nuclei scan also ran without issues.
remediation: Deploy WAF (Cloudflare, ModSecurity, AWS WAF) in front of nginx to filter malicious traffic.
